standard_prerequisites.name: Pullback along a cocontinuous morphism with trivial pullback of the structure sheaf
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemmas identifying g^* with g^{-1} when the pullback of the structure sheaf is the structure sheaf
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the identification g^* = g^{-1} and (g')^* = (g')^{-1} from condition (5), so the derived functors reduce to underived pullbacks.

standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing of the higher cohomology of the pullback of an injective sheaf
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma that H^p(U', (g')^{-1}I^q) = 0 for p > 0 for an injective abelian sheaf I and a cocontinuous v'
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the right acyclicity of the pullback of the terms of an injective resolution for the functor f'_*.

standard_prerequisites.name: Higher direct images as the sheaf associated to a presheaf of cohomology groups
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma identifying R^p f'_* with the sheafification of V' maps to H^p(u'(V'), -)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the translation of the vanishing of the cohomology groups over the objects U' into the acyclicity statement used by Leray's acyclicity lemma.

standard_prerequisites.name: Leray's acyclicity lemma
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Derived Categories, the lemma that a bounded below complex of objects acyclic for a left exact functor computes its right derived functor
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the conclusion that f'_*(g')^*I^bullet represents Rf'_*(g')^{-1}K.

standard_prerequisites.name: The commutativity of the underlying pushforward and pullback in the special square
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Modules on Sites, the lemma computing the pushforward of the pullback along the square involved for sheaves of modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the identity f'_*(g')^{-1}I^bullet = g^{-1}f_*I^bullet, which identifies the two sides of the base change map.

standard_prerequisites.name: Adjoints of exact functors preserve K-injectivity
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Derived Categories, the lemma that the right adjoint of an exact functor preserves K-injective complexes
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies, together with the exactness of g'_! in condition (6), the K-injectivity of (g')^{-1}I^bullet in the unbounded case.

core_obligations: Reduce to abelian sheaves (proof lines 9640-9645): by condition (5) one has g^* = Lg^* = g^{-1} and (g')^* = L(g')^* = (g')^{-1}, so it suffices to prove the statement on the derived category of abelian sheaves, by the cited comparison lemma.

Bounded below case (proof lines 9647-9663): for K in D^+(C) take a bounded below complex I^bullet of injective abelian sheaves representing K; the vanishing lemma gives H^p(U', (g')^{-1}I^q) = 0 for p > 0, and since R^p f'_* is the sheafification of V' maps to H^p(u'(V'), -) the pullback (g')^{-1}I^q is right acyclic for f'_*, so by Leray's acyclicity lemma f'_*(g')^*I^bullet represents Rf'_*(g')^{-1}K; the special-square identity then gives f'_*(g')^{-1}I^bullet = g^{-1}f_*I^bullet, which represents g^{-1}Rf_*K.

Unbounded case (proof lines 9665-9675): for K in D(C) take a K-injective complex I^bullet representing K; by the cited lemma on adjoints of exact functors and assumption (6), the pullback (g')^{-1}I^bullet is again K-injective; the special-square identity gives f'_*(g')^{-1}I^bullet = g^{-1}f_*I^bullet, and since f_*I^bullet represents Rf_*K and f'_*(g')^{-1}I^bullet represents Rf'_*(g')^{-1}K the two sides agree.
proof_roadmap: Use condition (5) to replace the derived pullbacks by the underived ones and reduce to abelian sheaves.
In the bounded below case resolve by injectives, check acyclicity through the explicit description of higher direct images, and apply Leray.
In the unbounded case resolve by K-injectives, using assumption (6) to keep K-injectivity under pullback.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a commutative square of ringed topoi coming from continuous and cocontinuous functors u, u', v, v' satisfying conditions (1)-(5) one has Rf'_* composed with (g')^* equal to g^* composed with Rf_* on D^+ of the modules, and that this also holds on the unbounded derived category when in addition g'_! is exact (statement lines 9594-9638). The proof (proof lines 9640-9681) treats the bounded below case by injective resolutions, acyclicity and Leray's lemma, and the unbounded case by K-injective resolutions using condition (6). H2: two resolution arguments with several independent inputs, written out in full.
